events.headline: Nvidia board unanimously accepted Jensen Huang's Nov 12 resignation (personal-conduct scandal) and on the Nov 17 earnings call ruled out reinstating him; interim CEO/CFO Colette Kress reported Q3 revenue up sharply YoY with strong Q4 guidance, but shares remain well off October highs amid the unresolved leadership vacuum and no permanent-successor timeline

St. Louis Fed's Musalem said up to four more rate hikes may be needed after October CPI ran hotter than expected (headline +0.4%, core +0.3%); Chicago Fed's Goolsbee called the report 'borderline disturbing'; futures price a ~90%+ probability of a 25bp December hike, while NY Fed's Williams ruled out a jumbo 50bp move

China's Ministry of Commerce extended its suspension of the expanded rare-earth/lithium-battery export controls by two months to Jan 10, 2027, easing near-term supply-disruption risk; separate April 2025 licensing curbs on seven medium/heavy rare earths remain in force

Tanker attacks and seizures continued in the Strait of Hormuz through mid-November (UKMTO-confirmed strike Nov 15-16, Iran claims of mine strikes and a seized Marshall Islands-flagged tanker on Nov 14); many specifics are Iran-sourced and unverified, but the disruption pattern itself is corroborated by UKMTO and maritime trade press
